description: Read what the Kineticist downloads page (manuals, schematics, ROMs, parts lists) shows the signed-in member: the file catalog with the same search and filters, 24 files a page, plus the member's access (free with an account, 20 downloads an hour). The site keeps no per-member download history. For a file's link, call kineticist_get_file_download_link with the row's game slug as gameId and its id as fileId. Read-only.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

format.description: File format filter, e.g. pdf, zip.

game.description: A game's slug: only that game's files.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

q.description: Game name search, as in the page's search box.

type.description: File type filter, e.g. manual, schematic, rom.

name: kineticist_get_my_downloads
title: Get your downloads
